concept: A small level-4 card anchored to one thing, with Next and Skip tour, a ring round the thing and no scrim.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a coach mark tour that darkens the whole page with a spotlight hole
default_to_avoid.kind: coach mark, onboarding tour, product tour, hint
default_to_avoid.why_not: a dark curtain with a hole blocks the page and moves focus away; Pane points without covering anything

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: the mark is a level-4 card like a popover and adds no scrim

derivation.consequence: nothing moves on its own; every motion answers something the reader did
derivation.form: it opens only on a first visit or after a change and never comes back once skipped

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: focus moves to the card when it opens and Esc skips the tour

options: B spotlight over a dark page
variants.reason: A points without blocking (P3). B covers the page. C teaches out of context.

anchor.why: the anchor wraps the thing without changing its layout

card.why: the card is a level-4 pane at a popover width

count.why: the step count is secondary in tabular figures

title.why: the title takes focus when the mark opens

description.why: the sentence is secondary at label size and says why the thing helps

actions.why: Skip tour and the loud Next sit together at the end

arrow.why: the arrow points from the card to the thing in the card tone

previewWrap.why: in a preview the thing and its card stack in place so docs can show them together

preview.why: in a preview the card sits in the page without rising or floating

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and marks so every part stays findable

data-coached.why: the thing pointed at is ringed while its mark is open

focus-visible.why: the focus ring shows when the part is reached by keyboard

@rise.why: the card rises a short distance and settles as it appears
